scope.profile: Material producers, root feature queries54/55 and owned element stores54/55, 2D/3D, explicit widths, defaults, partial failures, reference contributions and saved-width lifecycle.

behavior: SIZEMD writes material+2150; TXTURE writes +2154/+2158/+215c using zero-initialized integer readers, including partial/EOF mutation. Missing materials append and refresh before property read; neither property write refreshes afterward.

Feature54 sums modes1..6 as1,4,3,2,4,1; other modes contributezero. Feature55 uses own texture when material mode1cc8=0; otherwise sums immediate exact-ID referenced textures, including duplicate references without recursion and ignoring missing targets.

Texture modes1/2, second1, resolution1..4 give10,76,600,4784; mode3 gives7,50,388,3080. Unsupported known-mode parameters returnzero. Unknown nonzero mode prints Error in TEXTURE_DATA::countNumODFs() with newline to stdout and returnszero.

SIZESH/TXTODF read one raw mixed header without comma normalization. Invalid width/header EOF rejects before width mutation. Positive width changes root width before selector validation; nonzero selectors reject without allocation or rows.

Selectorzero invokes setter then getter allocation, preserving native shape history. Saved widths at object+adc/+ae0 update only for positive stored allocation count. Refresh, replacement and deactivation retain saved widths; object initialization/reset clears them.

Explicit default fills declared header rows at selected width; absent default preserves linear values and zero-initialized growth. Indexed rows scan every scalar before committing a complete valid row; earlier writes survive EOF. No trailing line consumption.
